verdict.rationale: Flutterwave documents a sandbox: test keys can simulate payments, transfers and webhooks, and you then switch to live keys. That covers the core 'test mode' part of the story. Nothing in the evidence covers test cards, decline scenarios, dispute simulation, or how closely the sandbox mirrors production. Missing for 10: documented test card numbers per scenario, decline simulation, dispute/chargeback simulation, evidence of production parity, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build and test the entire payment flow in a sandbox or test mode that mirrors production, with test cards for every scenario including declines and disputes

citations.quote: Use test keys to simulate payments, transfers, and webhooks in the sandbox, then switch to live keys and start accepting real payments.
